title: Hot Take: Golden State Warriors vs. Los Angeles Lakers: Game Highlights
author: Rico
summary: ESPN's "Golden State Warriors vs. Los Angeles Lakers: Game Highlights" is the headline. Rico has thoughts—mostly about how much mileage the league is still trying to squeeze out of a rivalry that peaked when both rosters looked completely different and everyone involved could still run back on defense.

content.value:
## The Headline

ESPN: **"Golden State Warriors vs. Los Angeles Lakers: Game Highlights"**

That's the kind of line that reads one way in October and a completely different way come April. Here's the read right now, before anyone's kept score. We're supposed to get excited every time these two franchises share a floor, as if the ghosts of Showtime and the We Believe squad are suiting up alongside whoever's actually healthy enough to play. The networks love this matchup because it *used* to mean something, and because casual fans still think it does. But highlights don't win games, and neither team has given us much reason to believe they're built for anything beyond a first-round exit and some nostalgic think pieces.
